title: ever LEORA|Flowy Pleated A-Line Chiffon Tie-Waist Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This classic A-line evening dress features pleated chiffon layers, v-neckline, light flutter sleeves, and a flowing silhouette, making it timeless and sophisticated. Pair it with black or metallic heels.


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.

Length: Floor-Length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: No zipper.

Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: No stretch.

Occasion: Bridesmaid dress, evening dress, banquet, formal birthday dress
